name: @kickside/kb10-ui
title: KickSide KB10 Browse
description: Engine-owned detail web component (kx-kb-browse) for the kb10 document/graph KB: lists nodes over the kb10 browse API and queues durable content deletes through the knowledge thread. Mounted by the knowledge surface via the engine's manage_ui_id.

kb-changed.description: Emitted after matching source-content materialization or delete completion so the host can refresh KB header stats.

navigate.description: Emitted with the selected node id so the host can deep-link it as /knowledge/<kbId>/<nodeId>.

wippy.description: Render the KickSide KB10 Browse module-owned Wippy surface inside a host application. Load it by its registered custom-element tag, pass only the documented properties when selecting or editing a resource, and listen for its typed events when the host must navigate, refresh, or accept a value. The component uses the injected Wippy proxy for authenticated APIs and remains isolated inside its Shadow DOM.
